title: Clawd X Digest
summary: OpenAI Codex Lead on Next-Gen Models: Tibo (@thsottiaux) stated current coding models will seem primitive in 2-3 months as next-generation models scale far beyond laptop capabilities.
SpaceXAI Engineer Deploys 20 GrokBot Agents: A SpaceXAI engineer revealed a Chief of Staff agent workflow managing 10-20 specialized GrokBot agents automating 90% of routine workloads.

ChatGPT Adds Event-Driven Triggers & Task Sharing: OpenAI updated ChatGPT Work scheduled tasks with event-driven triggers for Slack, Gmail, and GitHub, while expanding task creation to Free tier users.
Marvell Lands $120B Google Custom Chip Deal: Marvell Technology secured a multi-year deal with Google estimated to generate $120B over 6.5 years, more than doubling its annual revenue run rate.
GTA VI Extended Look Premieres on Netflix: Rockstar Games confirmed an exclusive extended look at Grand Theft Auto VI will premiere globally on Netflix this Thursday, August 27th at 3 PM ET.
